help.title: How to play
rules: You control a snake that moves continuously.
Eat the numbers (1–9) to grow and score points.
Each number gives points (multiplied by the level) and makes you longer.
After number 9 you advance to the next level: a new maze and higher speed.
You lose a life if you hit a wall or your own tail. You have 3 lives.
Controls: swipe on screen (mobile) or use the arrows / WASD (desktop).
Pause: the pause button or the P / Esc key.
Your best score is saved on this device.
